surveyMeta.description: An async choose-your-own-adventure for Ignatious featuring multi-layered zone exploration (3 layers deep per biome), cross-biome movement, inward progression toward Zone 9 Apex Core, and flexible Stress exits.
surveyMeta.title: Ignatious's Basalt Run Vanguard
surveyMeta.name: Ignatious's Basalt Run Vanguard

data.header: THURSDAY NIGHT: AFTER THE RACE ENDED

blocks.content: The Thursday night Resonance Race has concluded. As you step off the promenade deck of the Zephyr VIP airship, the air is cold and hums with static. Iggy is clutching his head from a massive grease-induced headache, and Loami steps in to guide him back to Block 12.
"Go on ahead, Lava Boy," Loami says, slinging Iggy's heavy arm over his broad shoulder. "I'll get the little guy settled into his cot. You look like you've got somewhere to be."
Ignatious, what did you do Thursday night after stepping off the Zephyr before Friday morning's exam?

ports.text: Meet Ambassador Cade Ashveil about clan integration
ports.subtext: Discuss Ash-Blood cultural spires and diplomatic standing in Harmony.

ports.text: Head to Hangar 12 to assist Captain Alistair Rookwood's pit crew
ports.subtext: Help pre-heat Team 1's Shatter Stamper crawler engine block.

ports.text: Scout the sub-level steam tunnels under Block 99 for lavsidian heat veins
ports.subtext: Follow your volcanic instincts into the pipe conduits searching for heat.

ports.text: Stay up all night cramming logistics formulas with Sarge and Lucky
ports.subtext: Trade Ash-Blood Genesis myths for annotated exam study guides.

ports.text: Head to the Apex Ring staging gantry before dawn
ports.subtext: Inspect the drop mechanisms and high-altitude winds.

blocks.content: Friday morning arrives. Thousands of first-year cadets sit in the cold stone grandstands of the Great Hall, clutching heavy copper-bound exam slates. Proctor Peter steps to the podium as the Scrivener spires hum with magic.
"Candidates! You have two hours to complete the Exploration 101 written slate. Module 5 covers Resonator Fluctuations, Ash-Blood Integration, and Emergency Energy Protocols. Begin!"
How do you answer the high-stakes exam questions on your copper slate?

ports.text: Apply Lucina's secret insight on Resonator Fluctuations
ports.subtext: Explain how global amplitude drops below Umbra crystal thresholds.

ports.text: Cite the Ash-Blood Genesis Myth of the Sky and Sea Dragons
ports.subtext: Demonstrate how ancient cultural myths hold tangible thermodynamic value.

ports.text: Detail Ambassador Cade Ashveil's Inverse Power Doctrine
ports.subtext: Argue that node strength is directly proportional to cultural integration.

ports.text: Use Sarge's Union Code: 'Always patch the Engine room first'
ports.subtext: Prioritize vital boiler survival over auxiliary housing systems.

ports.text: Rely on raw volcanic intuition and heat management math
ports.subtext: Calculate heat dissipation rates using Ash-Blood physiological formulas.

blocks.content: You are on the 7-square-mile floor of the Apex Ring arena basin. 50,000 cadets clash around you, and Senior Captains observe from the sky boxes. Where do you enter the Scavenger Manifest biomes?

blocks.content: You enter the scorching steam of Zone 2. Lucky has placed a heavy iron plate over the vent holding the Obsidian Thermal Tag (35 Pts), charging 5 sovereigns for access. Soot and Lance stand guard.
1.5 miles away, Squad 907 sees a massive steam plume erupt! Iggy points: 'Is that Ignatious wrestling an iron plate in Zone 2?!'

"That's real Ash-Blood fire! You mastered the deep volcanic heat, cadet!" Captain Scorch calls out.

data.header: ZONE 9 LAYER 2: GRAND OBELISK RUNE SURGE (#23)

blocks.content: You scale the Grand Obelisk in the center of the 3-mile basin! A 50-foot column of roaring orange flame erupts into the clouds! Across all 7 square miles, 50,000 cadets and every Senior Captain look up in awe. Iggy cheers: 'That's Ignatious! He lit the whole obelisk!'
"Squad 907 has established the premier Vanguard Signal of the Basalt Run!" Dean Vane and the Senior Captains officially log your crew for priority airship commissions.
